release_notes: Mandatory OPS 4.5.19 operations policy release. The overlapping Daily Operations Standards Check is retired and Opening Preparation Check remains the canonical daily opening task. Task photo groups and Urgent Issues support up to 10 photos, with clear instructions to photograph matching items together instead of separating every item. Staff, leaders and supervisors retain direct access to Daily Tasks, Training and SOP while sensitive Ops Control remains manager-only. Historical Tasks and photos are not deleted or overwritten.
